findings.detail: Priya's server has more than one name. The stem calls it "an experimental MCP server" and then "Priya's trial server". The options call it "Priya's experimental server", and the reason for A calls it "the trial server". One name should be used throughout, for example "Priya's experimental server".

blind_answer.reason: Shared team tooling belongs in the project-scoped .mcp.json, which is committed to version control, so anyone who clones the repo gets the backend server automatically. Personal or experimental servers belong in the user-scoped ~/.claude.json, so Priya's trial server stays private to her.
